name: Every clip ends on the channel's card
description: The card the channel ends every video on, played whole after the last word — from the endcard slot, so it is yours rather than the pack author's.
when: the clip was cut from a stream recording

then.prompt: The clip ends on the card in the `endcard` slot, played whole after the last word. If the slot is empty the clip ends on the last word; do not substitute anything for it.
